statement: n = 0 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → YuiMeasure s E = 0
proof:
intro hn s hs
subst n
obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h_H002
have hsing : E = {x} := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (Subsingleton.elim y x)
  · intro hy
    exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy) ▸ hx
rw [hsing]
unfold YuiMeasure
apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
refine iSup_le fun δ => iSup_le fun hδ => ?_
unfold YuiContent
refine iInf_le_of_le (fun _ : ℕ => ({x} : Set (YuiEucl 0))) (iInf_le_of_le ?_ ?_)
· constructor
  · exact Set.subset_iUnion (fun _ : ℕ => ({x} : Set (YuiEucl 0))) 0
  · intro i
    simp [Metric.ediam_singleton]
· simp [YuiCost, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hs]

  0 ≤ n →

              0 < a →
                YuiMeasure a A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) A ∧
                  (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧
                    (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ∞) ∧
                      (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧
                        (YuiMeasure a A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)) ∧
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)), 0 ≤ dimH A) ∧
              (∀ (k : ℕ) (A B : Set (YuiEucl k)), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B) ∧
                ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →
          n = 0 → ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → YuiMeasure s E = 0
